task.title: P6-158: Make the selection tray's 44px hit area match its accessible control
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-158. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**The tray's 44 px hit area and its accessible control are different elements** (was `P6-009d`; `selection_tray.rs:220-235`) — the hit area is a `<span>` with `on:click` and no `role`/`tabindex` while the accessible control is the inner button.
